arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 50000
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions above $500 made on cards whose type is prepaid debit, whether or not they carry a fraud label.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit cards' means card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' only, not 'Debit'.
All transactions are counted, including those with no fraud label; no fraud filter applied.
The whole data period (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31) is included, since no period was specified.
